snippet.title: Princess Diana's most colourful acts
snippet.description: Princess Diana's most colourful acts. When AIDS was still an unknown and therefore frightening disease, Diana, visiting a hospital, shook the hand of a sick person without gloves, showing everyone that the disease is not transmitted through touch. Advocating the banning of landmines, she visited Angola where, after meeting with victims, she walked through a strip of minefield that had not been fully cleared. And on sports day at Wetherby School, where her sons attended, the Princess didn't hide behind her title and took part in a mother's race. The photo of a sleeping Diana, taken at a ball in the museum, became a real sensation. The press was outraged until it became known that Diana was already pregnant with William. In 1992, the princess visited India, where she visited a leprosarium, and again shocked the world by touching the feet of a leprosy patient.

snippet.title: Princess Diana’s dance for Charles
snippet.description: Princess Diana's gift that shocked and angered Prince Charles. In 1985, Diana decided to surprise her husband in honor of his 37th birthday. That evening, the couple arrived at a charity event at the Royal Opera House in London. While the prince watched the performance, Diana quietly slipped out of the royal box to give a special gift to her husband, namely, to perform a dance with the famous ballet dancer Wayne Slip. And so Wayne and Diana appeared in front of the audience, dressed in a white combination dress. The audience went wild. All 2,500 people were at a loss for words. "Just don't drop the future Queen of England," Wayne worried. He feared that Diana was too tall for him - the difference in their height was 23 centimeters. The audience gave her a standing ovation, but Charles' sour expression showed that he was not satisfied. After the performance, he told her that she had once again drawn the audience's attention to herself.

snippet.title: "If you knew how I used to behave!" – Princess Diana Jokes About her Past (1985)
snippet.description:
In October 1985, Diana, Princess of Wales and Prince Charles, Prince of Wales sat with Alastair Burnet in Kensington Palace for a lengthy and intimate interview covering a wide range of subjects. In one moment, Burnet asked Princess Diana whether her new life as the Princess of Wales restricted her from living her life as she had before. "I think that's probably just as well," Diana replied, "if you knew how I used to behave!"

Michael Jackson and Princess Diana met on July 16, 1988, at Wembley Stadium during Jackson’s Bad World Tour in London. The meeting was legendary! 🌟

💖 What Happened?

Diana was a huge MJ fan and told him she loved "Dirty Diana"—but MJ almost removed the song from the concert out of respect!

They shared a private conversation, laughing and bonding over their love for charity and helping children.

MJ later revealed they had long phone calls, discussing their struggles with fame and the media.

snippet.title: The Secret Reason MJ Refused To Sing 'Dirty Diana' For Her 🤫 #DirtyDiana #RoyalFamily #History
snippet.description:
London, 1988. Michael Jackson. A sold-out concert. Princess Diana in the crowd. 💔

One song on the setlist — and one man quietly pulled it before the lights went down. Michael Jackson removed "Dirty Diana" himself. So her name would never sound like that in public.
Then Diana walked up to him anyway. Whispered something. Right in front of Charles. He stared. Cold. Still. Then stepped in: "What are you two talking about?"
She said: "Oh. Nothing."
The King of Pop protecting the Queen of People's Hearts — in the most silent, invisible act of kindness the world almost never knew. ✨
